messages.subject: mirt gpcm parameterization
parts:
I have parameters (Slope, Difficulty, Step.1) for either dichotomous or polytomous item with 3 response categories based on the above model. And I want to use mirt() with gpcm item type to estimate the model parameters (with some anchor items being fixed and the others being estimated). 

Below are what I did: 

tau1 <-  -1* Difficulty
tau2 <-  -1* Difficulty + Step.1
d1 <- Slope * tau1
d2 <- ifelse(is.na(Step.1), NA, Slope * (tau2 + tau1)) 

The pars matrix (sv) in the mirt function is defined as follows: 

  sv$value[sv$name == "a1"] <- Slope
  sv$value[sv$name == 'ak0'] <- 0
  sv$value[sv$name == 'ak1'] <- 1
  sv$value[sv$name == 'ak2'] <- 2
  sv$value[sv$name == "d0"] <- 0
  sv$value[sv$name == "d1"] <- d1
  sv$value[sv$name == "d2"] <- d2[!is.na(d2)]
  #set the anchor item parameters as fixed
  sv$est[sv$item %in% ItemID[Anchor==1]] <- FALSE

Is the above correct?

messages.subject: Re: mirt gpcm parameterization
parts:
Seems reasonable to me. Though it might not hurt to check with the dev versions new exported traditional2mirt() function (these classical IRT model transformation questions come up a lot, so I decided to export a previously internal function in the next major release). HTH. 

Phil
